title: Notes for Claude, and two bits from the site
thisBuild: The bug button (top row, second line): write or speak a note, pick Bug, Tuning, Feature, Question, Discuss or Wishlist, and send it to Claude.
Claude's replies show up under each note after you tap Check for replies.
If the app crashes, the next launch opens this panel so the crash can go along with a note.
Random drums on the Steps tab, like the site.
Picking a chord set that does not fit your scale moves the scale to the one it was written in, like the site.
watch: Tap pads fast with two fingers. Does anything lag or click?
Turn on Repeat, pick Arp up, switch to Keys and hold a chord.
Send one note to make sure GitHub opens signed in as TideClock.
limits: No performance effects yet (stutter, tape stop, echo, crush and the rest).
No importing your own sounds or recording from the mic yet.
Chop to pads and fit to tempo from the doctor's table are not in yet.
It stops playing a while after you leave the app.
